question: What runs, before the product exists?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P["You · in a browser"]
  subgraph cf["Runs on Cloudflare"]
    W["Web app"]
    A["API"]
    D[("Database · empty for now")]
  end
  P -- "opens the app" --> W
  W -- "asks on your behalf" --> A
  A -- "checks it can reach" --> D

steps.caption: You open the web app; it answers before anyone has signed in.
The web app reaches the API over a private binding, never the database.
The API says it is ready only when it can reach the database.
